page.notes: Catchword "folùm" as printed at the foot right, after "C" (signature mark). Words "uentus", "aura" etc. transcribed as printed. Long s rendered as s. Possible misreadings: "spurij" and "spiritus" (the printed "s" forms are long s; may be "fpurij"). The "C" at the foot is a signature mark, so it is placed in the bottom margin only as the catchword; no other signature recorded.
